Skills & Knowledge You’ll Gain in Pune

Data Science powers innovation across IT, BFSI, and product startups. Our Pune-focused program helps you build a solid foundation in statistics, Python, and machine learning, while advancing into deep learning, NLP, and Generative AI — all reinforced with live case studies and projects relevant to Pune’s job market.

With Hinjewadi IT Park, Magarpatta, and Kharadi fueling demand, Pune has emerged as a top hub for analytics and AI careers. Companies like Persistent, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, and Zensar are scaling data teams rapidly. This program connects you to that ecosystem with hands-on training, career mentorship, and placement pathways tailored for Pune’s industries.

Data Science Course Learning Objectives

01

High Demand Field

Data Science is among the fastest-growing careers in Pune’s IT and startup ecosystem. Our Data Science Course in Pune is designed to make you highly valued by companies and MNCs in sectors like BFSI, consulting, and SaaS.

02

Comprehensive Curriculum

We offer a well-rounded curriculum at our leading data science institute which covers essential tools and techniques. The flexibility ensures that you acquire practical skills in data science at your pace.

03

Your Learning

Our approach is to focus on holistic development with live sessions, hands-on projects, and masterclasses from experts. It builds your confidence and expertise throughout the course.

04

Final Project

The final project solidifies your expertise and demonstrates your ability to apply everything you’ve learned to solve real-world problems—boosting your portfolio and employability.
